in_marathi.name: Sudharsan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudharsan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has a good eye or a good vision, always looking at the good things in life and protecting his loved ones.

in_bengali.name: Sudharsan

in_bengali.long_meaning: Sudharsan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has a good eye or a good vision, always looking at the good things in life and protecting his loved ones.
